# TPC-DS Q65 — Store Sales Item Profit

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds
```

> [TPC-DS](../../tpc-ds.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS queries](index.md)

Reports store sales item revenue analysis

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, sc.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand FROM store, item, (SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) AS sa GROUP BY ss_store_sk) AS sb, (SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) AS sc WHERE sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave AND s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc LIMIT 100
```
